meta.name: Quarry Milestone Trophy
meta.description: An unlockable trophy seal honoring The Infinite Scriptorium of the Lithic Choir. These blind monastic archivists of Quill Hollow discovered that bedrock is frozen acoustic music, using zero-damage stalls and bell harmonics to shatter equal-depth contours. Forged by the Rivet Assayer from Lark Newt Rivet Ore, this permanent relic pauses battery and durability drain when auto-tools inevitably strike strict-locked blocks they cannot damage, provided you are well-rested.
